main-title.name: Main Settings
main-title.description: The following settings are related to the mod's main features, related to the live icon preview. Stuff like hitbox, offsets, trail, etc.

update-offsets-live.name: Update On Text Change
update-offsets-live.description:
Attempts to update the Sprite Offsets anytime the Text Inputs are changed. 
Toggleable in case this causes instability issues for anyone. Most notable issue is messing up the Touch Priority of the mod's popup. Installing the 'Better Touch Prio' mod is recommended in case you wanna keep this feature on.

animate-swing-fires.name: Animate Swing Fires
animate-swing-fires.description: Plays the in-game looping Fire Animation on the preview's Swing Fires

trail-outer-border.name: Show Trail Outer Edges
trail-outer-border.description: For Basic Trail Previewing (non-wave). If enabled, uses a texture that adds 2 lines to mark the outer edges of the trail's boundary. These lines loosely indicate the size of bigger trails, such as the Spike trail or the Fire trail.

trail-blending.name: Trail Blending
trail-blending.description: For Basic Trail Previewing (non-wave). If enabled, the trail preview will be blended with the background. If disabled, the trail will be fully opaque.

color-trail.name: Color Trail Preview
color-trail.description: For Basic Trail Previewing (non-wave). If enabled, the trail preview will be colored with the secondary color of the icon. If disabled, the trail will be white.

color-wave-trail.name: Color Wave Trail Preview
color-wave-trail.description: For Wave Trail Previewing. If enabled, the trail preview will be colored with the primary color of the icon. If disabled, the trail will be white.

hitbox-color.name: Hitbox Preview Color
hitbox-color.description: Defines what color to tint the hitbox preview square with.

hitbox-border-size.name: Hitbox Border Thickness
hitbox-border-size.description: Defines how thick the hitbox preview's border will be. Setting this to 'full' will make it a full fill instead of an outer border.

render-title.name: Render Settings
render-title.description: The following settings are related to the mod's Icon Rendering feature, which allows you to render icons as individual png images.

renders-path.name: Renders Folder
renders-path.description: Where to save the Icon Renders to. Defaults to this mod's config directory.

bg-color.name: Render Background Color
bg-color.description: Defines the BG color to use for the renders. Defaults to transparent (which is best, honestly)

extra-swing-space.name: Extra Swing Space
extra-swing-space.description: Adds extra space to Swing Renders to make sure the Swing Fires fit inside the render, and aren't cut off.

misc-title.name: Miscellaneous Settings
misc-title.description: The following settings are related to other features of the mod, some of which don't fit any of the other categories.

raw-part-names.name: Show Raw Part Names
raw-part-names.description: For Robot/Spider icons. Displays the raw part frame names in the popup's right-side Scrollable List, instead of using simplified names. This is a setting in case the automatic detection and simplification of frame names fails.
